question: _______ is present in tomato.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Oxalic Acid**__.

__
 
• **Oxalic acid **is present in tomatoes.
 
• Tomatoes are a good source of vitamin C and potassium.
 
• Other acids like citric acid and ascorbic acid are also present in tomatoes.
